name: Form Studio
purpose: Shape the selected tower's floor plates with taper, twist, plan shape and podium retreat, and return them as new geometry.
licence: no licence file yet (author's own repository)

sends: the selected tower: name, size, storeys, podium, footprint
destination.to: Form Studio, served from this computer (localhost:5577)
destination.stores: Form Studio keeps its own state in its page storage

limits: Returns floor polygons only: core, columns and structure stay in Form Studio
The tower keeps its Toolkit position and rotation
